title: Flutter bug/build analysis
whenToUse: Build/runtime Flutter errors need structured triage.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Diagnose Flutter issue: {{summary}}.

CONTEXT:
Versions: {{versions}}. Platform: {{platform}}.

INPUT:
Logs: {{logs}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- Separate build vs runtime
- Prefer official Flutter docs over guesses

OUTPUT:
Root cause hypotheses + commands

ACCEPTANCE:
Next command is concrete.

VERIFICATION:
Expected log signature.
improvedPrompt: Analyze Gradle/Xcode failure from this log; propose one command; no random dependency bumps.
